workspace.description: The workspace to list, by the slug list_workspaces answered; leave it out where the member belongs to one workspace alone.

taskId.description: Only the agents on this task, by the id a listed agent's task answered; leave it out for the whole workspace.

words.description: Only the agents whose title or task's name holds each of these words, whatever their case, to search the workspace by; leave it out for every agent.

offset.description: How many of the matching agents to pass over: the nextOffset an earlier list answered, to read the next page; leave it out for the first.
